cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get lunch right before your train. Taste this soup and I'll make the final adjustment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs salt, but I haven't time for a whole bowl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One spoonful will do. I'll season just that and you can give me the verdict.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take it in a flask. I really must go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent plan. Hold the flask while I pour, then check one drop from the lid. I won't send you off with a lunch you haven't signed off on.
